checkpoint.name: Alpha 2.0 - Sprinkler radius preview
checkpoint.summary: Added a lightweight visual coverage footprint for placed Tiny Sprinklers when the sprinkler is hovered or selected for placement.

implemented: Placed Tiny Sprinklers now show a cyan coverage footprint when hovered in the world-object dock or selected for placement.
The preview draws the actual affected tile cells: radius 1 by default, radius 2 when Sprinkler Network is purchased.
The preview is hidden while blocking overlays are open or when the placed object is offscreen.
Placed object sprite depth was raised so the sprinkler remains visible above the preview.
The preview updates immediately when placement mode starts, cancels, hover starts, or hover ends.
performanceNotes: The preview uses one Phaser Graphics object per placed world object and only draws while the sprinkler preview is active.
A small layout cache prevents redrawing unless radius, board scale, or screen position changes.
No full-field scans, physics bodies, or extra automation ticks were added.
The maximum preview draw is 9 cell outlines normally or 25 with Sprinkler Network.

checks: Clicked the Tiny Sprinkler dock icon.
Confirmed the 3x3 cyan footprint is visible around the placed sprinkler.

diffCheck.note: Only the existing LF-to-CRLF working-copy warning appeared.

knownCaveats: The preview currently exists only for Tiny Sprinkler because it is the only placed object with a tile-radius automation footprint.
The tile info panel can overlap part of the footprint, but the surrounding cells remain visible.
No special animation was added; this was intentionally kept simple for performance.
recommendedNextSteps: Start the next automation layer with a manager/tick scheduler instead of adding frame-based work.
Add one simple automation object or worker behavior at a time and test each pass with ?stress&perf&tiles=120.
Consider a compact automation status panel only after there are at least two active automation sources to compare.
